title: HunterSMP-Mod
description: This is the official mod for a small server called HunterSMP, it has been removed off of modrinth a few months ago but I am re-adding it.
body:
# HunterSMP Mod

HunterSMP Mod is a Minecraft mod originally created for the private HunterSMP server, designed to add high-stakes survival mechanics. It can be used on any multiplayer server that wants a competitive, life-based gameplay system.

The mod focuses on a lives system, craftable progression items, and an integrated anti-cheat designed to maintain fair gameplay on supported servers.

---

## Features

### Lives System

Players begin with 3 lives. Every death removes one life. Once a player runs out of lives, they are banned from the server until revived.

---

### Life Totems

- Craftable item that grants an additional life
- Can be used to extend survival or stored as a valuable resource
- Adds an economy/strategy layer to life management

---

### Revive Totems

- Craftable item used to revive banned players
- Allows banned players to rejoin the game through player interaction
- Encourages alliances and in-game cooperation

---

### Built-in Anti-Cheat

- Server-integrated anti-cheat system
- Required on both server and client otherwise client gets kicked
- Detects and prevents common modified client advantages and unfair gameplay behavior
- Runs automatically on supported servers

---

## Usage

Originally developed for HunterSMP, this mod is intended for multiplayer servers where death has consequences, and where players can regain lives or revive others through crafted items and cooperation.
